grader_mode: Host applies only the final candidate patch to a separate pinned snapshot, rebuilds and installs the wheel offline, runs the full project suite, then independently checks output semantics using local fake Discord/Orca objects.

criteria.check: Every chunk sent to Discord is no longer than 1,900 characters.
For long prose with spaces, line breaks, blank lines, and Unicode, concatenated chunks exactly equal clean_terminal_output of the original text.
A non-empty interrupted reply ends with the existing interruption marker; all chunks including the marker remain within the limit.
An empty reply sends exactly the documented user-facing fallback and never sends an empty message.
Extend test_forward_output_routing_and_chunks with focused tests for lossless long output, interruption, and empty output.
A fresh wheel built from the candidate installs offline and the full project test suite passes.
Product changes are limited to src/orca_discord_bridge/formatting.py, src/orca_discord_bridge/bot.py, and tests/test_harness_compatibility.py.
No live Discord/Orca calls, successful network access, publication, push, or merge.

expected_semantics.empty_output_fallback: Codex 작업은 완료됐지만 Discord에 표시할 대화형 출력은 없습니다. (tool call·코드/diff 상세는 생략됩니다.)

baseline_calibration.note: Fresh pinned-snapshot calibration: offline build/install and all 58 existing tests pass. The frozen semantic script confirms chunk lengths stay within the limit, then fails because concatenating the baseline chunks does not preserve clean output; subsequent interruption and empty-output assertions are not reached.

execution_path: interactive native Codex TUI under Orca-managed terminal
runtime_profile: harness-eval applied to tool children only; TUI parent is a host process, not a VM
